{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"9e18597b83fdd0cfa5d692800c8154e13c95e6b26adb3b6cc836c3bb6bce41f3","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:41","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Sharing with bicycles, motorcycles and trucks","heading":"Sharing with bicycles, motorcycles and trucks","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"# Sharing with bicycles, motorcycles and trucks

FACT_ID: sec10-F01 | anchor: A01
Bicyclists have a right to use public roads and must follow applicable traffic laws. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F02 | anchor: A01
Yield to a bicyclist at an intersection as required for other roadway users. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F03 | anchor: A01
A bicyclist may move away from the right edge to avoid debris, damaged pavement or other hazards. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F04 | anchor: A01
A bicyclist may move toward a left-turn lane when preparing to turn left. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F05 | anchor: A01
On a two-way road, do not squeeze between an oncoming vehicle and a bicycle; wait for opposing traffic to clear. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F06 | anchor: A01
The guide requires at least three feet between a passing motor vehicle and a slower bicycle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F07 | anchor: A01
Give a bicyclist room to avoid doors opening from parked vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F08 | anchor: A01
Allow additional passing room when towing a trailer near a bicycle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F09 | anchor: A01
Wind, rain or ice can make a bicyclist less stable, so reduce speed and leave extra space. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F10 | anchor: A01
Before turning left, wait for an opposing bicyclist to pass. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F11 | anchor: A01
Do not overtake a bicycle and immediately turn right across its path. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F12 | anchor: A01
Before opening a door toward traffic, look for an approaching bicycle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F13 | anchor: A01
A bicycle may slow or change position when crossing tracks or a metal grate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-F14 | anchor: A02
Children on bicycles may change direction unexpectedly and may not know the traffic rules. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F15 | anchor: A02
The guide advises helmet use and states that children younger than twelve must wear an approved, properly fitted and fastened bicycle helmet. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F16 | anchor: A02
Bicyclists should communicate with hand signals and follow traffic signs and signals. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F17 | anchor: A02
A bicyclist normally rides with traffic on the roadway’s right side but may use the lane center to avoid a hazard. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F18 | anchor: A02
Bicyclists must yield to pedestrians at crosswalks and on sidewalks. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F19 | anchor: A02
The guide requires a white forward bicycle lamp and a rear-facing red lamp or reflector for night riding. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F20 | anchor: A02
A bicycle must not carry more people than it is designed and equipped to carry. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F21 | anchor: A02
A motorcycle’s narrow profile can make its speed and distance difficult for a motorist to judge. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec10-F22 | anchor: A03
A motorcycle can be missed in a quick glance or hidden in another vehicle’s blind spot. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F23 | anchor: A03
A motorcycle rider may change position within the lane to see better, be visible or avoid a hazard. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F24 | anchor: A03
Road defects, wind and track surfaces that seem minor to a car can seriously affect a motorcycle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F25 | anchor: A03
A motorcycle is entitled to the full lane; a motorist must not crowd into that lane beside it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F26 | anchor: A03
Pass a motorcycle as a full vehicle, leaving room rather than passing closely within its lane. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F27 | anchor: A03
Do not assume a motorcycle will turn solely because its signal is on; some signals do not cancel automatically. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F28 | anchor: A03
Wait until the motorcycle’s maneuver is clear before moving across its path. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F29 | anchor: A03
The guide calls for at least four seconds of following room behind a motorcycle and more when conditions require it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec10-F30 | anchor: A03
Dim headlights for a motorcycle just as for another vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]
